terminologyReview: Guideline clarification: the revised distinction in references/common.md and references/ga.md is correct. The evidence agrees on three points. intl-workerd.json shows Intl.ListFormat and Intl.RelativeTimeFormat unsupported (English output) for eo, be and ga, while Intl.PluralRules returns native categories for all 18 locales. InstructionTemplates (packages/shared/src/instruction-template.ts) builds Intl.PluralRules for the content language and throws when a catalog omits a native count variant or a message. BotText.andList and transcriptLabelList join items only through the catalog's formatting.* patterns. So Bickr's own formatters never 'silently return English'; the English fallback is only a property of the platform Intl list and relative-time formatters, which Bickr does not use for these strings. One leftover: references/eo.md line 7 still says 'The runtime formatters silently return English, although plural rules work.' It should use the same wording as common.md and ga.md (be.md already does). This is a guideline edit only and changes no frozen English unit.

Korean terminology and register are consistent. Tool and schema descriptions use 합니다 (no plain-form sentence remains in draw_random_integers). First-person narration and recovery text use plain style, and the PLAN task line is plain. No 새로 고친 or 할 일을 다 마친 remains. The remaining 유지하세요 forms are direct instructions to the addressee, where the polite imperative is correct. Korean has only the other category, and every count keeps its placeholder with a counter (개, 번).

grok.terminologyReview: The revised Workers boundary is correct. Intl.ListFormat and Intl.RelativeTimeFormat fall back to English for Esperanto, Belarusian, and Irish, while Intl.PluralRules supports native categories. Bickr catalog formatters use explicit translated patterns and reject a missing entry, so the older phrase that runtime formatters silently return English does not describe Bickr. Korean is outside that fallback set and uses other for every count. Tool descriptions stay in 합니다. Instructions use 하세요, and participant narration and the self-written PLAN line stay plain. Ending a visit uses 방문을 마치는 and does not require every task to be finished. Control reminders name the allowed activities as alternatives with 중 무언가. Avatar refresh uses 갱신할 for the avatar still to be produced. 번 is the counter for visits.
